en: 3 Āyatanayamaka 3.2 Pavattivāra 3.2.3.
Uppādanirodhavāra (The Chapter on Arising and Cessation)
3.2.3.1 Present Chapter (Paccuppannavāra) 3.2.3.1.1 Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) Does the ear-base cease for that person for whom the eye-base arises? No.
Or, for whom the ear-base ceases, does the eye-base arise for that person? No.

For whom the eye-base arises, do the nose-base … form-base … mind-base … mental-object-base cease for that person? No. Or, for whom the mental-object-base ceases, does the eye-base arise for that person? No … [and so on] … For whom the ear-base ceases, does the eye-base arise for that person? No. For whom the eye-base arises, do the nose-base … form-base … mind-base … mental-object-base cease for that person?
No. Or, for whom the mental-object-base ceases, does the eye-base arise for that person? No … [and so on] …
Does the mind-base arise for that person for whom the mental-object-base ceases? No.
Or rather, does the mind-base arise for that person for whom the mental-object-base ceases? No.
3.2.3.1.2. Positive Plane (Anuloma-okāsa).

Where the eye-base arises … [the section on "where" (*yatthaka*) is not to be performed; the "where" section for the others is to be done similarly; the "where" section is the same in all three sections].
3.2.3.1.3. Positive Person-Location (*anuloma-puggalokāsa*):
For whom, where the eye-base arises, does the ear-base cease there? No.
Or, for whomsoever the ear-base ceases at a certain place, does the eye-base arise for that person at that same place? No... [and so on] ...
For whomsoever the mind-base arises at a certain place, does the mental-object-base cease for that person at that same place? No.
Or, for whomsoever the mental-object-base ceases at a certain place, does the mind-base arise for that person at that same place? No.
3.2.3.1.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them the ear-base does not cease?
For those who are possessing ears at the moment of death, the eye-base does not arise, yet it is not the case that the ear-base does not cease for them.
It ceases. For those being reborn without eye-faculty and for those passing away without ear-faculty, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base arises or ceases respectively.
Or, for whom the ear-base does not cease, does the eye-base not arise for them?
For those who are acquiring eye-faculty at birth, the ear-base does not cease, yet the eye-base does not fail to arise for them.
For those who are passing away without ear-faculty and those who are acquiring eye-faculty at birth without eye-faculty,
neither the ear-base ceases nor does the eye-base arise.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them the nose-base does not cease?
For those who are passing away while possessing a nose, the eye-base does not arise, yet it is not the case that the nose-base does not cease for them.
For those who are being reborn without eyes and for those who are passing away without a nose, the eye-base [does not arise]...
Does the nose base not arise and does it also not cease?
Or, conversely, for whom the nose base does not cease, does the eye base not arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with eyes, the nose base does not cease, yet for them the eye base [arises].
It does not arise. For those passing away from the non-percipient realm and for those being reborn without eyes, the nose base does not cease and the eye base does not arise.
Does the visible-object base not cease for one in whom the eye base does not arise?
For those possessing form who are passing away, the eye-base does not arise, yet the visible-object-base does not cease for them.
For those being reborn without eyes and for those of the formless realm who are passing away,
neither the eye-base arises nor does the visible-object-base cease.
Or rather: for whom the visible-object base does not cease, for that person does the eye-base not arise?

For those being reborn with eyes, the visible-object base does not cease, yet for them the eye-base does not fail to arise. For those passing away from the formless realm and for those being reborn without eyes, both the visible-object base [and the eye-base]...
The eye-base does not cease and the mind-base does not arise.
For one in whom the mind-base does not arise, does the eye-base not cease?
For those passing away with a mind, the eye-base does not arise, yet for them the mind-base does not [fail to] cease.
It ceases. For those beings who are being reborn without eyes and for those who are passing away without consciousness, the eye-base does not arise and the mind-base does not cease.
Or, conversely, for whom the mind-base does not cease, does the eye-base not arise for them?

For those who are being reborn with eyes, the mind-base does not cease, yet the eye-base does not fail to arise for them. For those who are passing away without consciousness and for those being reborn without eyes,
neither the mind-base ceases nor does the eye-base arise.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them the mental-object-base does not cease?
For all those who are passing away, the eye-base does not arise, yet for them the mental-object-base does not fail to cease.
For those being reborn who are without eyes, neither does the eye-base arise nor does the mental-object-base cease.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) does not cease, does the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) not arise for them?
For those being reborn with eyes, the base of mental phenomena does not cease, yet the eye-base does not fail to arise for them.
For those being reborn without eyes, neither the base of mental phenomena ceases nor does the eye-base arise.
[It] does not arise. (Based on the eye-base.
For whom the nose-base does not arise, does the visible-form base not cease for them?
For those passing away who possess the material form [of the sense organs], the nose-base does not arise for them, but it is not that the visible-form base does not [cease] for them.
It ceases. For those beings who are being reborn without a nose and for those who are passing away from the formless realm, neither the nose base nor the visible-form base arises or ceases.
Or else, for whom the visible-form base does not cease, does the nose base not arise for them?
For those being reborn who are without a nose, the visible-object base does not cease, yet the nose-base does not arise for them.
For those passing away who are formless and for those being reborn who are without a nose, neither the visible-object base ceases nor does the nose-base arise.
For whom the nose base does not arise, for them the mind base does not cease?
For those passing away with a mind, the nose base does not arise, but it is not the case that the mind base does not cease for them.
For those being reborn without a nose base and for those passing away without a mind, the nose base [does not arise]...
The mind-base does not arise and the nose-base does not cease.
Or, for whom the mind-base does not cease, does the nose-base not arise?
For those who are being reborn with a nose, the mind-base does not cease, but the nose-base does not [not arise]. (i.e., it does arise.)
It does not arise. For those passing away without mind and for those being reborn without a nose, the mind-base does not cease and the nose-base does not arise.
Does the mental-object base not cease for one in whom the nose-base does not arise?
For all those who are passing away, the nose-base does not arise, yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base does not cease for them.
For those being reborn who are without a nose, neither the nose-base arises nor does the mental-object-base cease.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental-object-base does not cease, does the nose-base not arise for them?
For those being reborn without a nose, the base of mental phenomena does not cease, yet the base of the nose does not arise for them.
For those being reborn without a nose, neither the base of mental phenomena ceases nor does the base of the nose arise.
(Based on the base of the nose.)
For whom the visible-base does not arise, for them the mind-base does not cease?
For those passing away with a mind, the visible-base does not arise, but it is not the case that the mind-base does not cease for them.
For those being reborn without form and for those passing away without a mind, neither the visible-base nor...
Does the mind-base not arise and the visible-form base not cease?
Or, conversely, for whom the mind-base does not cease, does the visible-form base not arise?
For those beings who possess a physical form at the moment of rebirth, the mind-base does not cease, yet for them the visible-form base does not [necessarily] arise.
It does not arise. For those passing away while mindless and for those being reborn in the formless realm, the mind base does not cease and the visible-form base does not arise.
Does the mental-object base not cease for one for whom the visible-form base does not arise?

For all those who are passing away, the sphere of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise, yet it is not the case that for them the sphere of mental objects (*dhammāyatana*) does not cease. For those being reborn in the immaterial realm (*arūpakā*), neither the sphere of visible form nor the sphere of mental objects ceases.
Or rather: for whomsoever the sphere of mental objects does not cease, for him the sphere of visible form does not arise?
For those being reborn in the realms possessing form (*sarūpakā*), the sphere of mental objects does not cease, yet it is not the case that for them the sphere of visible form [does not arise].
It does not arise. For those beings who are reborn in the formless realms, neither the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) ceases nor does the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) arise.
(End of the section based on the base of visible forms.
For whom the base of mind (*manāyatana*) does not arise, for them does the base of mental phenomena not cease?

For all those who are passing away, the mind-base (*manāyatana*) does not arise, yet the cognizable-base (*dhammāyatana*) does not cease for them. For those being reborn in a mindless state, neither the mind-base arises nor does the cognizable-base cease.
Or conversely, for whom the cognizable-base does not cease, does the mind-base not arise for them?
For those being reborn with a mind, the cognizable-base does not cease, yet the mind-base does not [necessarily] arise for them.
It does not arise. For those who are reborn in a mindless state, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of the mind ceases and arises.
3.2.3.1.5. Negative Spatial Analysis:
Where the eye-base does not arise … [and so on] … pe … .
3.2.3.1.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa) For whom, at which [place], the eye-base does not arise …pe….
(The "for whom" [yassa] and "for whom, at which place" [yassayattha] sections are identical.)
3.2.3.2. Past Section (Atītavāra) 3.2.3.2.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base had arisen, for that person did the ear-base cease? Yes.
Or, for whom the ear-base had ceased, had the eye-base arisen for them? Yes. ... [The same applies] ...
(The past questions regarding arising, cessation, and both arising and cessation, whether in direct or reverse order, are similar.
3.2.3.3. Future Section.
3.2.3.3.1. Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom eye-base will arise, for that person will ear-base cease? Yes.
Or else, for whom ear-base will cease, for that person will eye-base arise?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn in the formless realm—
at the moment of their rebirth, the ear-base will cease for them, but the eye-base will not arise for them. For others, however, both the ear-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.
For whom the eye-base will arise, for them will the nose-base cease?

For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death, the eye-base will arise, but the nose-base will not cease for them. For others, both the eye-base and...
Will the nose base arise and the eye base cease for that person? Or conversely, for whom the nose base will cease, will the eye base arise for them?
For those at the moment of rebirth in the sense-sphere who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika), and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna there.
For those beings who are being reborn there, the nose-base will cease, but the eye-base will not arise for them. For others, however, both the nose-base will cease and the eye-base will arise.
For whomsoever the eye-base will arise, will the visible-object-base cease for them? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the visible-base will cease, will the eye-base arise for them?

For those who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth—
for these, the visible-base will cease, but the eye-base will not arise for them.
In other persons, both the visible-object base will cease and the eye-base will arise.
For one in whom the eye-base will arise, will the mind-base … pe … the mental-object base cease? Yes.
Or else, for one in whom the mental-object base will cease, will the eye-base arise?

For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease, but the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) will not arise for them.
For others, both the base of mental phenomena will cease and the eye-base will arise. (Based on the eye-base.)
For whom the nose-base will arise, for that person will the visible-object-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the visible-object-base will cease, for that person will the nose-base arise?
For those at the moment of rebirth in the five-aggregate realm who are final-existence beings, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms...

For those who will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the visible-object base will cease, but the nose-base will not arise for them. For others, both the visible-object base will cease and the nose-base will arise.
For whomsoever the nose-base will arise, will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object base cease for them? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease, will the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) arise for them?

For those at the moment of rebirth who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika), and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) or the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), will attain final nibbāna there—the base of mental phenomena will cease for them, but the base of the nose will not arise for them. For others...
For those [beings], the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease and the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) will arise.
For whom the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) will arise, for that person will the base of mind (manāyatana) …pe… the base of mental phenomena cease? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the base of mental phenomena will cease, for that person will the base of visible forms arise?
For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there,
the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease, but the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) will not arise for them. For others,
both the base of mental phenomena will cease and the base of visible forms will arise.
For whom the mind-base (manāyatana) will arise, for them the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) will cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object-base will cease, for them the mind-base will arise?

For those at the moment of rebirth who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika), the mental-object-base will cease, but the mind-base will not arise for them. For others, both the mental-object-base will cease and the mind-base will arise.
3.2.3.3.2. Positive Section (Anuloma-okāsa): Where the eye-base will arise … [as above] … 3.2.3.3.3.
Positive Section on Individuals (Anuloma-puggalokāsa)
For whom the eye-base will arise at a certain place, for that person the ear-base will cease at that place? Yes.
Or, for whom the ear-base will cease at a certain place, for that person the eye-base will arise at that place?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the ear-base will cease there, but [the eye-base will not necessarily arise].
And for them, the eye-base will not arise there. For others belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the ear-base will cease and the eye-base will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye-base will arise there, will the nose-base cease for that person there?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the eye-base will arise there, but the nose-base will not cease there for them.
For those belonging to the sense-sphere, both the eye-base will arise there and the nose-base will cease there.
Or else, for whomsoever the nose-base will cease there, will the eye-base arise there for him?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-base will cease there,
but the eye-base will not arise there for them. For others in the sense-sphere realm,
both the nose-base will cease and the eye-base will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye-base will arise at a certain place, for that person the visible-object-base will cease at that place? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the visible-object-base will cease at a certain place, for that person the eye-base will arise at that place?
For those final-existence beings reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for non-percipient beings, the visible-object-base [will cease] at that place.

[It will] cease, but for them the eye-base will not arise there. For others in the five-aggregate realm, for them both the visible-object-base and the eye-base will cease and arise there respectively.
For whomsoever the eye-base will arise there, for that person will the mind-base cease there? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base will cease at a certain place, will the eye-base arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm, the mind-base will cease there, but the eye-base will not arise for them there. For others in the five-aggregate realm [it is otherwise].
For those persons, the mind-base will cease there and the eye-base will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye-base will arise there, for that person will the dhamma-base cease there? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the dhamma-base will cease there, for that person will the eye-base arise there? [No.]
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm,
the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease there, but the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) will not arise there for them.
For others in the five-aggregate realm, both the base of mental phenomena will cease and the eye-base will arise there.
(Based on the eye base.
For whomsoever the nose base will arise at a certain place, for that person will the visible base cease at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the visible base will cease at a certain place, for that person will the nose base arise at that same place?
For those attaining rebirth in the sense sphere who are in their final existence, and for those in the fine-material sphere,
the visible-object base will cease there, but the nose-base will not arise there for them. For others in the sense sphere, both the visible-object base will cease and the nose-base will arise there.
For whomsoever the nose-base will arise there, for that person the mind-base … pe … the mental-object-base will cease there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental-object-base will cease there, for that person the nose-base will arise there?
For those who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere.
In that case, the base of mental phenomena will cease, but the base of the nose will not arise for them there.
For others belonging to the sense-sphere, both the base of mental phenomena will cease and the base of the nose will arise there.
(End of the section based on the base of the nose.)

For whom will the visible-object base arise at a certain place, for that same person will the mind base cease at that place? For non-percipient beings, the visible-object base will arise there, but the mind base will not cease there for them.
For those of the five-aggregate realm, both the visible-object base will arise and the mind base will cease there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the mind-base will cease at a certain place, will the visible-form base arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those non-percipient beings, the mind-base will cease there, but the visible-form base will not arise for them there. For others in the five-aggregate realm, [both will arise].
For those persons, the mind-base will cease there and the visible-form base will arise there.
For whomsoever the visible-form base will arise there, for that person will the mental-object base cease there? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mental-object base will cease there, for that person will the visible-form base arise there?
For those destined for their final existence who are reborn in the five-aggregate plane and for those in the formless plane, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease there,

but the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) will not arise there for them. For others— namely, those in the five-aggregate plane and non-percipient beings— both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms will cease and arise there respectively.
(Based on the sense-base of visible form.
For whomsoever the mind-base will arise at a certain place, for that person will the mental-object-base cease at that place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental-object-base will cease at a certain place, for that person will the mind-base arise at that place?
For those undergoing final existence and for non-percipient beings, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease there,
but the base of mind (manāyatana) will not arise there. For others— those with four aggregates and those with five aggregates—
both the base of mental phenomena and the base of mind will cease and arise there respectively.
3.2.3.3.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the eye-base will not arise, for that person will the ear-base not cease? [Answer:
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain Parinibbāna there.
For those beings being reborn [there], the eye-base will not arise, yet it is not the case that the ear-base will not cease for them.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm,
will attain final Nibbāna while passing away— for these, neither the eye-base nor [the ear-base] will arise.
And the ear-base will not cease.
Or, for whom the ear-base will not cease, will the eye-base not arise for that person? Yes.
For whom the eye-base will not arise, will the nose-base not cease for that person?

For those destined for their final existence in the sense-sphere who are being reborn there, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn in the formless realm while being reborn there,
the eye-base will not arise, but it is not the case that the nose-base will not cease for them.
[This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere, and for those destined for their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial realms.
For those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna, at the moment of their death,
the eye-base will not arise and the nose-base will not cease.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the nose-base will not cease, will the eye-base not arise for them?
For those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere, will attain final nibbāna there, at the time of their death, the nose base will not cease,
but it is not the case that the eye base will not arise for them. [This is true] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere,
for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, and for those who, having been reborn in the immaterial sphere, will attain final nibbāna there.
For those passing away, neither the nose-base nor the eye-base will cease.
Will the visible-object-base not cease for one whose eye-base will not arise?
For those undergoing final existence in the five-aggregate realm who are being reborn there, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna.
For those beings being reborn [there], the eye-base will not arise, but it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not cease for them.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the immaterial plane, and for those who, having been reborn in the immaterial plane,
will attain final Nibbāna while passing away from there— the eye-base will not arise for them.
And will the visible-object base not cease for that person?
Or, for whom the visible-object base will not cease, will the eye-base not arise for that person? Yes.
For whom the eye-base will not arise, will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object base not cease for that person?
For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn in the formless realm,
the eye base will not arise, but it is not the case that the mental object base will not cease for them. For those who are attaining final nibbāna,
neither the eye base nor the mental object base will cease.
Or for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) [will arise] …pe…? Yes. (Based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) will not arise, will the visible-object-base (*rūpāyatana*) not cease for them?

For those attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate realm as final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*), and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, [will not return].
For those who will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the nose-base will not arise, but it is not the case that the visible-object base will not cease for them.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who will attain final Nibbāna after being reborn in the formless realm—at the moment of their death—the nose-base [will not arise]... [and so on].
[It is] such that the visible-object base will not arise and the visible-object base will also not cease.
Or, conversely, for whom the visible-object base [will not arise], etc.? Yes.
For whom the nose-base will not arise, will the mind-base, etc., up to the mental-object base, not cease?
For those in their final existence who are being reborn, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere,
will attain final Nibbāna there, the nose-base will not arise, but it is not the case that the mental-object base will not cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna,
neither the nose-base nor the mental-object base will cease.
Or again, for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) [will not cease]...? Yes.
For whom the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) will not arise, for them the base of mind (manāyatana)... will the base of mental phenomena not cease?
For those at the moment of rebirth in their final existence (pacchimabhavika), and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna there.

The visible-object base will not arise for them, but the mental-object base will not cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the visible-object base nor the mental-object base will cease.
Or, for whom the mental-object base [will not arise] …? Yes.
For whom the mind-base (manāyatana) will not arise, for them the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) will not cease?
For those entering their final existence (pacchimabhavika), the mind-base will not arise, but it is not the case that for them the mental-object-base will not cease.
For those attaining final Nibbāna (parinibbanta), neither the mind-base nor the mental-object-base will cease.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease, will the base of mind (manāyatana) not arise for that person? Yes.
3.2.3.3.5. Negative Spatial Analysis: Where the base of eye (cakkhāyatana) will not arise … [and so on] … pe … .
3.2.3.3.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-Puggalokāsa) For whom eye-base will not arise at a certain place, for that person will ear-base not cease at that place?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, eye-base will not arise there for them.

And yet, for them, the ear-base will not cease there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base will arise there, nor will the ear-base cease there.
Or, for whomsoever, wherever...? Yes, it is so.
For whom the eye-base will not arise at a certain place, for them the nose-base will not cease at that place?
For those beings of the final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the eye-base will not arise there, but it is not the case that the nose-base will not cease for them there.
[This is also true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm and for those in the fine-material sphere...
For those beings in their final existence, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm,
the eye base will not arise and the nose base will not cease there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the nose base will not cease there, will the eye base not arise there for them?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the nose base will not cease there, yet the eye base will not fail to arise there for them.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere, for those in their final existence in the fine-material sphere,
for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, neither the nose base nor the eye base will arise there.
For whom the eye-base will not arise at a certain place, for them will the visible-object-base not cease at that place?

For those final-existence beings being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for non-percipient beings, the eye-base will not arise there, but it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not cease there for them. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm.
For those immaterial beings, neither the eye-base nor the visible-object-base will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever and wherever ... [as before] ...? Yes.
For whomsoever and wherever the eye-base will not arise, will the mind-base not cease there for that person?
For those attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, and for those in the formless realms, the eye-base will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mind-base will not cease there for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, neither the eye-base nor the mind-base will cease there.
Or for whom, at whatever place … [as before] …? Yes.
For whom, at whatever place, the eye-base will not arise, for them there, will the mental-object-base not cease?

For those who are to be reborn in their final existence in the five-aggregate realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm—for them, there, [the mental-object-base will not cease].
The eye-base will not arise for them, but it is not the case that the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base will cease there.
Or, for whomsoever at whatever place … [as above] …? Yes. (End of the section based on the eye-base.)
For whom the nose-base will not arise at a certain place, for them the visible-object-base will not cease at that place?

For those final-existence beings reborn in the sense-sphere and for those in the fine-material sphere, the nose-base will not arise there, but it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not cease for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane.
For those beings who are formless, neither the nose base nor the visible-object base will arise there.
Or conversely, for whom and where … [as before] …? Yes.
For whom and where the nose base will not arise, will the mind base not cease there for them?
For those undergoing their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, for those in the fine-material sphere, and for those in the immaterial sphere, the nose-base will not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mind-base will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose-base nor the mind-base will cease there.
Or for whomsoever, wherever … [as before] …? Yes.
For whomsoever, wherever the nose-base will not arise, for that person there, will the mind-object base not cease?
For those who are to be reborn in their final existence, for those entering the womb of the sense-sphere realm, and for those of the fine-material and immaterial realms—for them [it is so].
In that case, the nose base will not arise, yet for those persons there the mental-object base will not fail to cease.
For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the nose base nor the mental-object base will cease there.
Or, for whomsoever and wherever ...? Yes, it is so. (End of the section based on the nose base.)
For whom the visible base will not arise at a certain place, for them the mind base will not cease at that place?

For those final-existence beings reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those non-percipient beings, the visible base will not arise there, but it is not the case that the mind base will not cease for them there. [It will not cease] for those who are attaining final nibbāna.
In that case, will the visible-object base not arise and the mind base not cease?
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind base does not cease at a certain place, will the visible-object base not arise there for them?
For non-percipient beings, the mind base does not cease there, but the visible-object base does not [fail to] arise for them there either.
It will not arise. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the mind-base (*manāyatana*) nor the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) will cease there.
For whomsoever the visible-form base will not arise in a certain place, will the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*) not cease for them there?

For those who are taking rebirth in the five-aggregate realm as final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*), and for those non-percipient beings (*arūpa*), the visible-form base [will not arise] there.
[The visual object base] will not arise for them there, but the mental-object base will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the visual object base nor the mental-object base will cease there.
Or, for whom and where...? Yes, it is so. (Based on the visual object base.)
For whom the mind-base will not arise at a certain place, for them the mental-object-base will not cease at that place?

For those attaining rebirth in their final existence and for non-percipient beings, the mind-base will not arise there, but it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna, both the mind-base and...
[Will] the base of mental phenomena not arise and the base of mental phenomena not cease?
Or, conversely, for whomsoever and wherever the base of mental phenomena will not cease, will the base of mind not arise for them there? Yes.
3.2.3.4. Chapter on the Present and the Past.
3.2.3.4.1. Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base arises, for that person did the ear-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the ear-base ceased, for that person does the eye-base arise?
For all those passing away who are without the eye-base, the ear-base had ceased,
but the eye-base does not arise for them. For those being reborn with the eye-base, both the ear-base had ceased and the eye-base arises.

(Just as in the section on arising, the questions concerning the present and the past were analyzed, so too in the section on arising and cessation, the questions concerning the present and the past should be analyzed both in direct order and in reverse order. 3.2.3.5.
Section on the Present and the Future. 3.2.3.5.1.
Direct Order: Person.
For whom the eye-base arises, for that person will the ear-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the ear-base will cease, for that person does the eye-base arise?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn who are not to obtain the eye-base, the ear-base will cease.
And the eye-base does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with eyes, the ear-base will cease and the eye-base arises.
For whom the eye-base arises, will the nose-base cease for them?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the eye base arises,
but the nose base will not cease for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye base arises and the nose base will cease.
Or again, for whom the nose base will cease, does the eye base arise for them?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are not to obtain the eye base, the nose base will cease, but the eye base does not arise for them. For those being reborn who are to obtain the eye base, both the nose base and...
The eye-base will cease and the eye-base arises.
For whom the eye-base arises, will the visible-object-base cease for that person? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the visible-object-base will cease, does the eye-base arise for that person?

For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-faculty, [the eye-faculty does not arise]... For those being reborn with eye-faculty, the visible-object base will cease and the eye-faculty arises.
For one in whom the eye-faculty arises, will the mind-base cease? Yes.
Or else, for one in whom the mind-base will cease, does the eye-faculty arise?

For all those who are passing away and for those who are being reborn without eye-sensitivity, [the mind-base will cease but the eye-base does not arise]... For those who are being reborn with eye-sensitivity, the mind-base will cease and the eye-base arises.
For whom the eye-base arises, will the mental-object-base cease for them? Yes.

Or else, for whom the mental-object-base will cease, will the eye-base arise for them? *Note: The ellipsis (*pe*) indicates that the intermediate steps of the logical progression should be supplied according to the established pattern.*

For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-sensitivity, [the nose-base does not arise]... For those being reborn with eye-sensitivity, the base of mental objects will cease and the eye-base arises.
For whom the nose-base arises, will the base of visible forms... the mind-base... the base of mental objects cease for them? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the base of mental objects will cease, does the nose-base arise for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose-faculty, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease,
but the nose-base (ghānāyatana) does not arise for them. For those being reborn with a nose-faculty, both the base of mental phenomena will cease and the nose-base will arise.
For whom the visible-base (rūpāyatana) arises, for that person will the mind-base (manāyatana) …pe… the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) cease? Yes.
Or else, for whom the mental-object-base will cease, for that person does the visible-base arise?
For all those who are passing away and for those non-material beings who are being reborn, the mental-object-base will cease [but the visible-base does not arise].
And yet, the visible-object base does not arise for them. For those being reborn with the material form base, the mental-object base will cease and the visible-object base arises.
Does the mental-object base cease for one for whom the mind base arises? Yes.
Or for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) [will cease]...?

For all those passing away and for those mindless beings being reborn, the base of mental phenomena will cease, but the base of mind (manāyatana) does not arise for them. For those mindless beings being reborn, the base of mental phenomena [ceases], and...
The mind-base will cease and the mind-base arises.
3.2.3.5.2. Positive Plane: Where the eye-base arises …pe… (and so on).
3.2.3.5.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-puggalokāsa) In whom, and in what [place], does the eye-base arise, for that person, in that place, will the ear-base cease? Yes.
Or rather, in whom, and in what [place], will the ear-base cease, for that person, in that place, does the eye-base arise?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are without eye-sense, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane,
the ear-base will cease there, but the eye-base does not arise there for them. For those being reborn with eye-sense, both the ear-base will cease and the eye-base will arise there.
For whom and where the eye-base arises, for them will the nose-base cease there?

For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the eye-base arises there, but the nose-base will not cease there for them. For those with eyes who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, [the eye-base arises there].
The eye-base arises and the nose-base will cease.
Or, for whomsoever and wherever the nose-base will cease, does the eye-base arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-base [will cease] there.

[The nose base] will cease, but the eye base does not arise for them there. For those possessing the eye base who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, both the nose base and the eye base will cease and arise respectively there.
For whomsoever the eye base arises there, will the visible-object base cease for them there? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the visible-base (rūpāyatana) will cease at a certain place, does the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) who are not possessed of eyes, and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta)—for these, the visible-base will cease there, but the eye-base does not arise for them there. [However, it does arise] for those possessed of eyes.
For those who are being reborn there, the visible-object base will cease and the eye-base arises.
For whomsoever the eye-base arises there, will the mind-base cease for them there? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mind-base will cease there, does the eye-base arise for them there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are without eye-faculty, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane or in the immaterial plane,
the mind-base will cease there, but the eye-base does not arise there for them. For those being reborn with eye-faculty, both the mind-base will cease and the eye-base will arise there.
For whom, where the eye-base arises, will the mental-object-base cease there? Yes.
Or rather, for whom, where the mental-object-base will cease, does the eye-base arise there?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the mental-object-base will cease there.
And yet, the eye-base does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn with eyes, the dhamma-base will cease and the eye-base will arise there. (Based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the nose-base arises there, will the visible-object-base cease for them there? Yes.
Or again, for whomsoever the visible-object base will cease at a certain place, does the nose-base arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere or the fine-material sphere, the visible-object base will cease there, but the nose-base does not arise for them there. [However, it does arise] for those with a nose.
For those beings being reborn there, the visible-object base will cease and the nose-base arises.
For whom, where the nose-base arises, will the mind-base cease there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, where the mind-base [arises]...?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without nose-faculty, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for those of the fine-material sphere,
and for those of the immaterial sphere— the mind-base ceases there... [and so on] ...but for those being reborn with nose-faculty,
there the mind-base will cease and the nose-base arises.
For whom, where the nose-base arises, will the mental-object-base cease there? Yes.
Or for whom, where the mental-object-base [arises]...?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the mental-object-base [will cease] there... [but] for those with a nose...
For those beings being reborn there, the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will cease and the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) arises.
(End of the section based on the nose-base.
For whom, where the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) arises, will the mind-base (*manāyatana*) cease there?

For those being reborn among the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) arises there, but for them the [other bases] do not arise there... [and so on] ...for those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*), for them there...
[and so on]. Or rather, for whom and where does the base of mind (*manāyatana*)...

[and so on]? For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*), for them there... [and so on] ...for those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, for them there both the base of mind will cease and the base of visible form arises.
For whom, where the visible-object base arises, will the mental-object base cease there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom, where the mental-object base [arises] …pe…?
For all those who are passing away and for those immaterial beings being reborn, the mental-object base will cease there.
And yet, the visible-object base does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn with the material base, the mental-object base will cease and the visible-object base arises there.
Does the mental-object base cease for that person there where the mind-base arises? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease at a certain place, does the base of mind (manāyatana) arise for them there?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn without consciousness, the base of mental phenomena will cease there, but the base of mind does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn with consciousness, [the base of mind arises] there.
The sphere of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will cease and the sphere of mind (manāyatana) arises.
3.2.3.5.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala):
For whom the eye-sphere (cakkhāyatana) does not arise, will the ear-sphere (sotāyatana) not cease for them?
For all those passing away who are not to obtain the eye-base at rebirth, the eye-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the ear-base will not cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna there—at the moment of their passing away—the eye-base [does not arise].
Does the ear-base not arise and will it not cease?
Or, conversely, for whom the ear-base will not cease, does the eye-base not arise for them? Yes.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, will the nose-base not cease for them? Yes.
For all those passing away who are eyeless at the moment of rebirth, the eye-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the nose-base will not cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the immaterial realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna there—at the moment of their passing away, [the eye-base does not arise].
The eye-base does not arise and the nose-base will not cease.
Or, for whomsoever the nose-base will not cease, does the eye-base not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the nose-base will not cease.
And yet, the eye base does not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those who,
having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial plane, will attain final nibbāna there— at the moment of their death,
neither the nose base nor the eye base will cease or arise respectively for them.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, will the visible-object-base not cease for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not cease for them. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm.
And for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna, at the time of their passing away, neither the eye-base arises nor will the visible-object-base cease.
Or, for whom the visible-object-base [does not arise]...? Yes, it does.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, will the mind-base …pe… the mental-object-base not cease for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye-base does not arise;
yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the eye-base nor [the other bases] arise.
And the base of mental phenomena will not cease for him.
Or rather, for whom the base of mental phenomena [will not cease]...? Yes. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
For whom the nose-base does not arise, will the visible-form base not cease for him?
For all those passing away who are not to be reborn with a nose, the nose-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the visible-object base will not cease for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of passing away—for these, both the nose-base and [the visible-object base do not arise].
[The visible object base] does not arise and will not cease.
Or rather, for whom the visible object base [does not arise and will not cease]? Yes.
For whom the nose base does not arise, will the mind base ... up to ... the mental-object base not cease for them? Yes.
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose, the nose-base does not arise,
yet it is not the case that the mental-object base will not cease for them. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna,
neither the nose-base arises nor will the mental-object base cease.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) [does not cease]...? Yes. (The section based on the base of the nose.
For whom the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise, will the base of mind (*manāyatana*)... or the base of mental phenomena not cease for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn in the formless realm (*arūpakā*), the base of visible forms does not arise; and yet—

For them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) arises nor does the base of mental phenomena cease.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena [does not arise]...? Yes, it is so.
For whom the mind-base does not arise, for them will the mental-object-base not cease?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without consciousness, the mind-base does not arise;
yet it is not the case that for them the mental-object-base will not cease. For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the mind-base nor [the mental-object-base] arises.
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not cease, does the base of mind (manāyatana) not arise for them? Yes.
3.2.3.5.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa).
Where the eye-base does not arise … [as above] … 3.2.3.5.6.
Negative Person-Space: For whom, where the eye-base does not arise, will the ear-base not cease there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm who are not to obtain eye-sense, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the eye-base does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the ear-base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, and for non-percipient beings and those in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base will cease there.
Or again: For whomsoever the ear-base will not cease at a certain place, for that person does the eye-base not arise there? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, for that person will the nose-base not cease there? [It will not.
For those passing away from the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, the eye-base does not arise there.
It does not arise, yet for them the nose base will not cease there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere,
for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, and for non-percipient beings and those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the eye base nor the nose base will arise or cease there respectively.
Or, for whomsoever the nose-base will not cease at a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the nose-base will not cease there, yet the eye-base does not fail to arise for them there.
[This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere and for those passing away from the fine-material sphere.
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, neither the nose base nor the eye base will cease there.
For whom the eye base does not arise at a certain place, will the visible-object base not cease for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, and for non-percipient beings—[for these, the eye base does not arise and the visible-object base does not cease].
In that case, the eye-base does not arise for them there, yet it is not that the visible-object-base will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for those in the formless plane, neither the eye-base arises nor will the visible-object-base cease there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the visible-object-base will not cease there, does the eye-base not arise for them there? Yes.
For whom the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, will the mind-base not cease for them there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, and for those non-percipient beings, the eye-base does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mind-base will not cease for them there. [This is so] for those attaining final Nibbāna.
For non-percipient beings, neither the eye-base nor the mind-base will cease there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind-base will not cease at a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for them there? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) not cease for them there?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-sensitivity, the eye-base does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base arises or will cease there.

Or conversely: For whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will not cease at a certain place, for that person the base of the eye (*cakkhāyatana*) does not arise there? Yes. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) does not arise at a certain place, for that person the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) will not cease there?

[It will not cease] for those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without noses, and for those belonging to the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*).
In that case, the nose base does not arise for them there, yet the visible-object base will not cease for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for those in the immaterial plane, neither the nose base nor the visible-object base will cease there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the visible-object base will not cease there, for that person the nose base does not arise there? Yes.
For whom, where the nose-base does not arise, will the mind-base not cease there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without a nose, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, and for those of the fine-material and immaterial spheres—
the nose-base does not arise there for them, but it is not the case that the mind-base will not cease there for them.
For those non-percipient beings who are attaining final nibbāna, the nose base does not arise there, and the mind base will not cease there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind base will not cease at a certain place, does the nose base not arise for them there? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose base does not arise at a certain place, will the mental-object base not cease for them there?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose-base does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the mental-object base will not cease for them there. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the nose-base nor the mental-object base arises or will cease there.

Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will not cease at a certain place, does the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) not arise for them there? Yes. (End of the section based on the base of the nose.
For whomsoever the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise at a certain place, will the base of mind (*manāyatana*) not cease for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm, the base of visible form does not arise there; yet, it is not the case that the base of mind does not cease for them.

In that case, the mind-base (manāyatana) will not cease. For those who are attaining final nibbāna (parinibbāna) and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the visible-form base (rūpāyatana) arises nor does the mind-base cease there.
Or, conversely: for whomsoever the mind-base will not cease in a certain place, does the visible-form base not arise for them there?
For those being reborn among the non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the mind-base (*manāyatana*) will not cease there,
yet the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna (*parinibbāna*) and for those passing away from the non-percipient realm,
the mind-base will not cease there, and the visible-form base also does not arise there.
For whom the visible-object base does not arise at a certain place, for that person will the mental-object base not cease at that place?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn in the immaterial plane, the visible-object base does not arise at that place;
yet it is not the case that the mental-object base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna, the visible-object base [does not arise] at that place...
[Is it the case that] the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) does not arise and will not cease?
Or rather, for whomsoever and wherever the base of mental phenomena will not cease, for that person and in that place, does the base of visible form (rūpāyatana) not arise? Yes.
For whomsoever and wherever the base of mind (manāyatana) does not arise, for that person and in that place, will the base of mental phenomena not cease? Yes.
For all those passing away and for those being reborn without consciousness, the mind-base does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not cease for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the mind-base nor the mental-object-base arises or will cease there.
Or rather: For whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not cease at a certain place, for that person does the base of mind (manāyatana) not arise at that place?
Yes. 3.2.3.6. Chapter on the Past and Future.
3.2.3.6.1. Positive Person.
For whom the eye-base had arisen, will the ear-base cease for them?

For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death—
the eye-base had arisen for them, but the ear-base will not cease for them.
For others among them, the eye-base had arisen and the ear-base will cease.
Or else, for whomsoever the ear-base will cease, had the eye-base arisen for that person? Yes.

(Just as in the section on cessation, the questions regarding the past and future—whether concerning "whom," "where," "whom-and-where," in direct order, and in reverse order—were analyzed, so too should the questions regarding the past and future in the section on arising and cessation be analyzed.)
The Section on Arising and Cessation.
The Section on Process is finished.
